detail: Full summary: Suggested hardening, NOT implemented: have the server report its build identity (package version plus dist build timestamp or git sha) via twining_status or the startup banner, so a stale process is detectable rather than inferred from mtimes. Cheap, and it would have turned this investigation into a single call.
